definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."ProjectElementUUID","d"."ProjectElement","d"."ProjectUUID","d"."ProjectElementDescription","d"."ProcessingStatus","d"."PlannedStartDate","d"."PlannedEndDate","d"."ActualStartDate","d"."ActualFinishDate","d"."SortingNumber","d"."EntProjectElementType","d"."IsProjectMilestone","d"."ForecastedEndDate","d"."MilestoneApprovalStatus","d"."IsMainMilestone","d"."TaxJurisdiction","d"."FunctionalLocation","d"."WBSElementIsBillingElement","d"."WBSElementInternalID","d"."ProjectInternalID","d"."ParentObjectUUID","d"."ProjectElementOrdinalNumber","d"."WBSIsStatisticalWBSElement","d"."CompanyCode","d"."ControllingArea","d"."CostCenter","d"."CostingSheet","d"."FactoryCalendar","d"."FunctionalArea","d"."InvestmentProfile","d"."Location","d"."Plant","d"."ProfitCenter","d"."ResponsibleCostCenter","d"."ResultAnalysisInternalID","d"."LeadingSalesOrder","d"."LeadingSalesOrderItem","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."CreationDateTime","d"."LastChangedByUser","d"."LastChangeDateTime","d"."HierarchyNodeUUID","d"."EntProjectSettlementElement","d"."EntProjIsSettlmtRuleInherited","d"."EntProjProfitabilitySegment","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_ENTERPRISEPROJECTELEMENT_S4_CURR_Delta" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'I_ENTERPRISEPROJECTELEMENT'
